rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for putting a light, device, or other operation into an inactive state.
This is the all-purpose choice when something is no longer on, attached to, or together with A.

example.english: As soon as the plug came off the socket, the machine went off.
example.traditional: 個插頭一離開插座，部機就即刻熄咗。
example.jyutping: go3 caap3 tau4 jat1 lei4 hoi1 caap3 zo6 bou6 gei1 zau6 zik1 hak1 sik1 zo2

rows.note: Use this directional complement when an action or movement carries someone or something away from the reference point.

example.jyutping: nei5 ling1 di1 laap6 saap3 zau2 laa3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when a device is inoperative or food has gone bad, rather than when something is deliberately switched off.

example.jyutping: bou6 din6 waa6 waai6 zo2 laa3

rows.note: Use this for being off work or school, or having a day off, but not for every sense of a free or non-peak period.

example.english: I’m off work tomorrow, so I don’t have to go in.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 fong3 gaa3 m4 sai2 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this for something being removed, detached, or bitten off, often after another verb such as 咬.

example.english: They bit the meat off the chicken thigh.
example.traditional: 佢一啖咬甩咗雞髀啲肉。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 daam6 ngaau5 lat1 zo2 gai1 bei2 di1 juk6

rows.note: Use this when something is wrong, inappropriate, or does not seem right.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 daap3 on3 m4 ngaam1 wo3

rows.note: Use this for being temporarily away from the usual workplace or school, with A as 工 or 學.

example.english: I’m off work tomorrow, so I can sleep in.
example.traditional: 我聽日唔使返工，可以瞓晏啲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 m4 sai2 faan1 gung1 ho2 ji5 fan3 aan3 di1

rows.note: Use this when an amount or percentage is deducted from a stated price.

example.english: This shirt is one hundred dollars off on the spot.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 zik1 coeng4 gaam2 jat1 baak3 man1

rows.note: Use this when clothing, shoes, or another item has been removed or is no longer being worn.

example.english: I take my shoes off before going inside.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ceoi4 zo2 deoi3 haai4 sin1 jap6 uk1

rows.note: Use this specifically to say that something is outside the boundary or area of A.

example.english: The car is parked off the road.
example.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 paak3 zo2 hai2 maa5 lou6 ceot1 min6
